trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the PS5 trophy screen to find any of the other 54 awards you still need. Check the separate in-game 100% goal during cleanup and verify the platinum once the list is complete.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Look for Gone Fishing in the story and play through its closing objective. Check the trophy when the mission ends and keep this separate from Cal's fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Follow the main story through the end of Chapter 1. Check your trophy list at the chapter break before starting your Chapter 2 checklist.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Pick up the main story after Chapter 1 and finish the next chapter. The trophy gives no optional objective to watch for during Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Continue the story until Chapter 3 is credited as finished. Use the chapter transition as a checkpoint for reviewing your other story awards.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the main assignments in Chapter 4 and verify the chapter trophy. Keep going for the separate final mission trophy if it is still locked.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Stay on the main story through the finale and wait for mission completion before checking the gold. Keep a separate save before the finale if you want a fallback for earlier objectives.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: When Breakfast Run appears in the story, finish the entire assignment. The list gives no chapter or extra performance condition for this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow the story into The Cartel Heist and through its ending. Keep its checkmark separate from Maximum Withdrawal, which has its own vault counter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Watch for Child's Play among the story assignments and finish it. The description points to the mission result itself and gives no dialogue or choice requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners when it turns up in your mission list. Use the mission title as your cue because the trophy gives no chapter number or special objective.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown to its finish for the story credit. Keep a save as you approach airport content if you are also investigating Catch Me If You Can, whose exact trigger is unclear.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow Operation Savage Glory through its final objective when the story presents it. Check for the unlock on completion, since the description gives no medal target.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game's completion percentage to guide your final cleanup. Compare that reading with your unfinished content, since this checklist tracks PS5 awards rather than the game's internal requirements.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build toward 250 credited stunts as you explore Leonida. Check that the tally moves after your attempts before relying on any particular stunt or repeating it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample one of every distinct activity type as it becomes available. Keep a list by type so visits to several venues for the same activity do not hide a missing category.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Work through all 42 Shooting Range challenges and record which entries already have gold. Return to anything below gold and check the list again for challenges you skipped or unlocked later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Track one Top Fun Drone Race win per venue wherever you find the event. If the trophy stays locked, look for a venue missing its first win before repeating a completed one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Record each distinct race after your first win and move on to another event. Aim for 20 unique wins and check the count if two events look similar.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Watch for Cal's competitive fishing event and use its own scoring rules to finish ahead. Confirm that the result credits a win over Cal before moving on.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Start an arcade title you can finish and play through to its completion result. The list leaves the game and any score threshold unspecified.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's assignments and revisit the strand if only its opening jobs are complete. Mark this once the closing mission has been credited.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Track Kenton's strand by the contact name, since the trophy gives no mission title. Continue his follow-up jobs until the final one is recorded as finished.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Accept Billy's missions when they appear and watch for another assignment after each completion. The requirement is the end of his chain, so save the checkmark for the closing job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Track completed stranger threads across Leonida by contact. Count each thread once its last assignment is finished, and look for a new thread if your total is below eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Pick up Randy's jobs as the game offers them and keep checking for follow-ups. Verify the trophy after his last assignment before crossing his strand off your route.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Look for Tyrone's mission sequence and complete his concluding assignment. If the trophy remains locked, look for an unfinished follow-up from Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Use the meditation interaction at each eligible spot you find across Leonida. Log spots after meditating, since passing by a marker does not establish completion.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Look for a hunt linked to Bret and follow the objective for its unique animal. Keep a save before the encounter if you want a retry, since replay or respawn behavior is unclear.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Sort your card finds by set and use each set's missing entries to plan where to search next. Finish three whole sets before marking the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at eligible locations as you travel and track confirmed entries by place. Work toward 100 distinct locations and check a fresh site if a repeat fails to advance the tally.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Review the game's Challenge entries and prioritize those that are still unfinished. Verify that each completed entry advances the tally toward 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Use an in-game sequence where your partner is present and verify four stars before starting your escape. Check for the unlock once the Wanted Level clears, and keep a save before partner sequences if you are unsure you can repeat them.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan three in-game shop stops during the same outing with your partner. Confirm your Wanted Level stays active through the third stop and restart from a prior save if the chain breaks and you cannot start it again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Seek unfamiliar vehicles as you travel between other objectives. Check which encounters count as discoveries in your game before using them toward the 100 target.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for an in-game encounter with at least five eligible enemies before triggering Combat Focus. Check for all five within one activation and keep a save before the encounter if you need to retry.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Watch for an unusual departure opportunity at VCIA and keep a save before committing to it. The required action and any connection to a named mission are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Treat the mention of Rhinos as a cue to pay attention when the game presents one. Preserve a save before the encounter because the hint gives no confirmed action or retry method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Keep a save before an eligible jewelry store attempt and watch for in-game detection cues throughout. If you are detected, return to the prior save if you cannot restart the attempt normally.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Track completed in-game Bank Vault events and make sure the escape is credited each time. Check for five successful entries before treating the vault tally as done.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Look for an Armored Truck event and follow it through the escape objective. Confirm the award once the event ends, since reaching the truck alone does not cover both conditions.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Use the map and any exploration tally to spot parts of Leonida you have yet to visit. Work those gaps into your collectible sweep and confirm the trophy after the last credited area.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: When the game identifies an Illegal Operation and its gang, note the gang after completing the event. Target groups still missing from your list before repeating one you already covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: On Ocean Beach, watch for a cocktail interaction that fits the view clue. Keep a save before leaving any promising encounter because the list does not identify a venue or confirm repeat access.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: When a vehicle showroom sequence appears, keep a save before taking the exit. The clue suggests a smash-through departure, but the exact showroom and trigger are unclear.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Use Kolt & Associates' bowling alley as your location cue and look for an interaction connected to bowling. Keep a save before leaving the sequence if available, since the clue does not specify the required result.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Watch for an interaction or choice about a partnership during the story. The hint gives no contact, location or confirmed action, so keep a save before committing to a likely moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Keep rotating saves before decisions that look difficult to undo. The description hints at a choice but leaves both the relevant decision and the required outcome open.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Watch for an encounter that explicitly offers a second try or repeats an earlier event. Keep a save before advancing it because the hint does not say which event or result counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Follow up on unusual encounters and check the trophy list when they resolve. Keep a rotating save if an event seems one-time, since the description offers no reliable location or trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Look for a situation where the game allows a melee drive-by and check the trophy after a successful attempt. Keep a save if the opportunity is tied to an encounter, since the required target and repeat access are unspecified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game contacts who handle Marked Bills and track what you actually earn from those transactions. Check the total against $250,000 before moving on to unrelated money goals.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Track credited shop spending as you buy items during the run. Use the shop total to work toward $100,000 and keep your property purchases on a separate list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Use the in-game garage property listings as your shopping checklist. Revisit them during cleanup for later entries and check each one for purchase confirmation.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the in-game Scooter Bros app to register eligible vehicles. Count successful registrations and check for ten before marking the trophy earned.
